demos.name: Agent Identity Academy
demos.description: Standalone port of the Agent Identity Academy: 13 lessons, one per agent type and per control, each with a frame-by-frame evidence reel, mock claim diffs and a diagram-studio diagram, over the discover/register/authenticate/authorize/govern lifecycle. Mock-only by design; every token is a labelled mock sample.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7831). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: docker compose up -d --build (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock-only by design: no live mode, zero outbound calls in any mode; AIA_MODE_REAL=1 only enables the rule-19 Real switch. Derived from the AI-DEMO2 Academy prototype, rewritten customer-neutral.
